hunks.baseline: No further surprises occurred in the great battle that day across the vast snowfield.
hunks.sol: No further surprises came in the great battle that day across the vast snowfield.

hunks.baseline: Just a few hours earlier, the forces of Dark Heaven had flaunted their overwhelming might. Now they were no more than candles before the wind, while the allied forces—led by Supreme Peak masters and wave after wave of reinforcements—were like a tremendous storm.
hunks.sol: Just a few shichen earlier, Dark Heaven’s forces had seemed overwhelmingly powerful. Now they were candles before the wind, while the allied forces—led by Supreme Peak masters and reinforced again and again—were a tremendous storm.

hunks.baseline: A storm made of steel and killing intent, tearing through everything in its path.
hunks.sol: A storm of steel and killing intent, tearing through everything in its path.

hunks.baseline: Fountains of blood erupted all around them.
hunks.sol: Fountains of blood erupted on every side.

hunks.baseline: With thick blood mist draped over them like cloaks, the allied soldiers charged, stabbing and cutting down every enemy in their path without the slightest hesitation.
hunks.sol: With thick blood mist draped over them like cloaks, the allies charged, stabbing and cutting down every enemy in their path without the slightest hesitation.

hunks.baseline: And death repaid with death. That was the law of this world—the Murim—and the very essence of war.
hunks.sol: And death repaid with death. That was the law of this world—of Murim—and the very essence of war.

hunks.baseline: A guard’s spear pierced his arm. Arrows and swords flying from somewhere slashed through his face and chest.
hunks.sol: A guard’s spear pierced a cultist’s arm. An arrow and a sword from somewhere tore through his face and chest.

hunks.baseline: Before they could finish their eight-character doctrine, the enemies fell, spraying blood. The allied forces trampled over their bodies and closed in around the enormous slaughterhouse.
hunks.sol: Before the cultists could finish their eight-character doctrine, they fell, spraying blood. The allied forces trampled over their bodies and tightened the cordon around the vast slaughterhouse.

hunks.baseline: Against Dark Heaven’s cultists, who had lost their reason, words like *persuasion* and *capture alive* were luxuries. The immense sacrifices the allied forces had made here today had left them with no mercy to spare.
hunks.sol: Against Dark Heaven’s cultists, who had lost their reason, persuasion and taking prisoners were luxuries. The immense sacrifices the allies had suffered here today had made them forget mercy.

hunks.baseline: Least of all the band of fighters who had joined last, yet were now sweeping through the enemy ranks at the very front.
hunks.sol: That was truest of the band who had joined last, yet were now sweeping through the enemy ranks at the very front.

hunks.baseline: Blood-soaked robes fluttered in the wind.
hunks.sol: Blood-soaked robes fluttered.

hunks.baseline: They plunged straight into the heart of the enemy lines as if they didn’t care whether they lived or died. Their movements were as elusive as the wind, and the sword light that surged along the blade of the old man at their head was cruelly dazzling.
hunks.sol: They plunged straight into the heart of the enemy lines as if they cared nothing for their lives. Their movements were elusive as the wind, and the sword light surging from the old man’s blade at their head was cruelly dazzling.

hunks.baseline: Chunks of flesh, no longer recognizable as such, and blood flew in every direction.
hunks.sol: Flesh mangled beyond recognition and blood flew in every direction.

hunks.baseline: And the tremendous roar of the allied forces as they crashed into the enemies’ broken formation and crushed it completely.
hunks.sol: And the tremendous roar of the allied forces as they crashed into the broken enemy formation and crushed it completely.

hunks.baseline: “Charge! Keep charging!”
hunks.sol: “Charge! Charge!”

hunks.baseline: In that moment, the allied forces were one wave, though each part had a different color.
hunks.sol: In that moment, the allied forces were a single wave, though each part had a different color.

hunks.baseline: The Embroidered Uniform Guard charged in ranks, keeping their composure amid the chaos.
hunks.sol: The Embroidered Uniform Guard charged in orderly ranks, keeping their composure amid the chaos.

hunks.baseline: Then there were the Zhongnan Sect Disciples, whose numbers had dwindled drastically since the start—and even the mysterious mounted fighters who had suddenly appeared and joined the allied forces.
hunks.sol: Then there were the Zhongnan Sect Disciples, far fewer than at the start—and the mysterious mounted fighters who had appeared out of nowhere to join the allies.

hunks.baseline: The ground trembled as if an earthquake had struck.
hunks.sol: The ground shook as if an earthquake had struck.

hunks.baseline: Their deafening shouts echoed without end. The forest of steel packed across the land engulfed the invaders, blooming with countless flowers and branches.
hunks.sol: Deafening shouts echoed without end. A forest of steel filled the land, engulfing the invaders and blooming with countless flowers and branches.

hunks.baseline: Red flowers made of blood and bone, white branches made of bone.
hunks.sol: Red flowers of blood and white branches of bone.

hunks.baseline: That was the end of the long, brutal battle.
hunks.sol: That was how the long, brutal battle ended.

hunks.baseline: Another half day passed. Of the fully thirty thousand Dark Heaven cultists, not one still stood on the battlefield of his own will.
hunks.sol: Another half day passed. Of the nearly thirty thousand Dark Heaven cultists, not one remained on the battlefield of their own will.

hunks.baseline: Generally, when at least thirty percent of a fighting force has been killed or wounded and the surviving troops’ will falters, they’re judged incapable of continuing to fight—and are considered annihilated.
hunks.sol: Generally, if at least thirty percent of a fighting force has been killed or wounded and the survivors’ will falters, the force is judged incapable of continuing to fight—and considered annihilated.

hunks.baseline: But here in the Murim, what lay before Jin Taekyung at this very moment was different.
hunks.sol: But here in Murim, what lay before Jin Taekyung at this moment was different.

hunks.baseline: No, perhaps those two characters still couldn’t express the whole thing.
hunks.sol: No, perhaps even that word wasn’t enough.

hunks.baseline: The word I couldn’t bring myself to say lingered on the tip of my tongue. I looked around, my gaze heavy.
hunks.sol: The word he couldn’t bring himself to say lingered on the tip of his tongue. Taekyung looked around, his gaze heavy.

hunks.baseline: The once-white snowfield. The faces of the corpses submerged in pools of blood, eyes wide open.
hunks.sol: The once-white snowfield. The faces of corpses submerged in pools of blood, their eyes wide open.

hunks.baseline: And the bloodshot eyes searching for enemies who might have survived, probing through rivers of blood and mountains of corpses.
hunks.sol: And the bloodshot eyes searching for enemies who might have survived, picking through rivers of blood and mountains of corpses.

hunks.baseline: The sword that came down hard pierced the chest of an enemy writhing among the countless corpses.
hunks.sol: A sword came down hard, piercing the chest of an enemy who had been writhing among the countless dead.

hunks.baseline: A miracle wouldn’t happen twice. If you survived once, it was practically a misfortune.
hunks.sol: A miracle wouldn’t happen twice. Having survived once was a misfortune.

hunks.baseline: Had his life ended sooner, he could have met a much quicker, more peaceful death.
hunks.sol: If he’d died sooner, his end would have been much quicker and more peaceful.

hunks.baseline: At the dreadful sound of bone and flesh being crushed—and the killing intent, even more vivid than the sound—the faces of the Fire Dragon Pavilion members beside me stiffened.
hunks.sol: At the dreadful sound of bone and flesh being crushed—and the killing intent, even more palpable than the sound—the faces of the Fire Dragon Pavilion members beside Taekyung stiffened.

hunks.baseline: I raised a hand to stop them before they could finish.
hunks.sol: Taekyung raised a hand to stop them before they could finish.

hunks.baseline: I knew what they wanted to say.
hunks.sol: He knew what they wanted to say.

hunks.baseline: This wasn’t murder. It was slaughter, like butchering livestock.
hunks.sol: This wasn’t killing. It was slaughter, like butchering livestock.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, Taekyung understood the feelings of those giving such a cruel end to enemies who no longer had the strength to resist.
hunks.sol: Yet he also understood the feelings of those giving such a cruel end to enemies who no longer had the strength to resist.

hunks.baseline: I tossed the words to the Fire Dragon Pavilion members and slowly started walking.
hunks.sol: He tossed the words to the Fire Dragon Pavilion members and slowly started walking.

hunks.baseline: One step. Then another. With each step, unbearable fatigue washed over me. But someone’s hand reached out from somewhere and steadied my swaying body.
hunks.sol: One step. Then another. Unbearable fatigue washed over him with each step, but a hand reached out from somewhere and steadied him when he staggered.

hunks.baseline: “I believe I told you to wait.”
hunks.sol: “I’m pretty sure I told you to wait.”

hunks.baseline: At my mutter, which came out almost as if I were talking to myself, Sama Pyo shrugged.
hunks.sol: At Taekyung’s mutter, almost spoken to himself, Sama Pyo shrugged.

hunks.baseline: “Did you? I don’t remember hearing that.”
hunks.sol: “Well, I didn’t hear you.”

hunks.baseline: “You’ve heard it now. Step back.”
hunks.sol: “You’ve heard me now. Step back.”

hunks.baseline: My voice was firmer than ever. Sama Pyo’s reply, which rang out a moment later, was just as firm.
hunks.sol: Taekyung’s voice was firmer than ever. Sama Pyo’s answer was just as firm.

hunks.baseline: I stared at him, eyes widening. Sama Pyo gave me a faint smile.
hunks.sol: Taekyung’s eyes widened. Sama Pyo gave him a faint smile.

hunks.baseline: He met my gaze calmly and added, “I can’t keep dragging you or anyone else into this. Whatever comes, I have to face it alone.”
hunks.sol: He met Taekyung’s gaze calmly and added, “I can’t keep bringing trouble to you or anyone else. Whatever happens, I’ll have to bear it alone.”

hunks.baseline: He knew.
He knew why I was still clinging to consciousness when I’d been on the verge of collapse for a long time.
hunks.sol: He knew why Taekyung, who had been at his limit for a long time, was still clinging to consciousness.

hunks.baseline: And he knew how great the danger waiting at the end of the road he now had to walk alone might be.
hunks.sol: And he knew how great a danger might be waiting at the end of the road he now had to walk alone.

hunks.baseline: Even so, he could remain so calm because he had already made up his mind.
hunks.sol: He could remain calm because he had already made up his mind.

hunks.baseline: His voice trailed off as his gaze shifted to Taishan.
hunks.sol: His voice trailed off. His gaze shifted toward Taishan—and Taekyung, who had been watching him, cut in.

hunks.baseline: Taekyung, who had been watching him, cut in.
Sama Pyo fell silent for a moment. Then he understood what Taekyung meant and gave a short laugh.
hunks.sol: Sama Pyo fell silent for a moment. Then he understood what Taekyung meant and let out a short laugh.

hunks.baseline: “You’re right. I have to look after him to the very end. No matter what.”
hunks.sol: “You’re right. I have to look after him to the very end. I will.”

hunks.baseline: Swallowing the words he could not bring himself to say, Sama Pyo set off alone.
hunks.sol: Swallowing the words he couldn’t bring himself to say, Sama Pyo set off alone.

hunks.baseline: Of course he did.
hunks.sol: Of course Sama Pyo did.

hunks.baseline: It had been recent—not years or months ago, but barely more than a month.
hunks.sol: It had been barely more than a month—not years or even months ago.

hunks.baseline: And he could guess well enough why I’d brought it up.
hunks.sol: And he could guess why Taekyung had brought it up.

hunks.baseline: “Of course. Right before we left for the west, Elder Namho and Taishan came looking for me themselves.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. Right before we left for the west, Elder Namho and Taishan came looking for me.”

hunks.baseline: He had already read it, then read it again—over and over.
hunks.sol: He had already read it, then read it again. Over and over, even as the two approached his door.

hunks.baseline: Even as the two men’s footsteps approached his door.
“You’re usually punctual to the second, but that day you dragged your feet. Like someone waiting for a visitor.”
hunks.sol: “You’re usually punctual to the second, but that day you dragged your feet. Like you were waiting for someone to come looking for you.”

hunks.baseline: At my mutter, Sama Pyo abruptly stopped walking.
hunks.sol: Sama Pyo stopped walking at Taekyung’s quiet remark.

hunks.baseline: They stood out wherever they went, and you couldn’t help hearing them.
hunks.sol: They stood out wherever they went, and there was no missing the sound of them.

hunks.baseline: That had been true for Sama Pyo, too, alone in his quarters that night, reading the secret letter.
hunks.sol: Sama Pyo had heard them that night too, alone in his quarters with the secret letter.

hunks.baseline: Waiting for the oldest friend who would come looking for him before anyone else.
hunks.sol: Waiting for his oldest friend, who would come looking for him before anyone else.

hunks.baseline: No—or for the old Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent who was always stuck to Taishan’s side.
hunks.sol: No—for the old Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent who was always at Taishan’s side.

hunks.baseline: And, deep down, he had hoped Namho would figure out at least a little of the secret he couldn’t bring himself to say aloud.
hunks.sol: Deep down, he had hoped Namho would notice at least something of the secret Sama Pyo couldn’t say aloud.

hunks.baseline: He had hoped Namho would be on his guard because of it.
hunks.sol: That he would take it as a warning.

hunks.baseline: At my quiet question from behind him, Sama Pyo resumed his halted steps.
hunks.sol: At Taekyung’s quiet question from behind him, Sama Pyo resumed walking.

hunks.sol: He had wanted to believe in him until the very end, whatever it took.

hunks.baseline: But when that trust was betrayed, he didn’t want the people beside him put in danger.
hunks.sol: But if that trust was betrayed, he didn’t want the people beside him put in danger.

hunks.baseline: Even if that meant they might suspect him, too, he didn’t care, as long as everyone else would be safe.
hunks.sol: Even if they suspected Sama Pyo too, he didn’t care, as long as it kept everyone safe.

hunks.baseline: That was what it meant to live as the blood relative of Sima Gong, the Black Night King, and the Young Sect Leader of the Black Dragon Demon Gate.
hunks.sol: That was what it meant to live as the son of Sima Gong, the Black Night King, and the Young Sect Leader of the Black Dragon Demon Gate.

hunks.baseline: And yet it was strange.
hunks.sol: Yet something about it had been strange.

hunks.baseline: Even after Namho’s gaze toward him had grown sharper and more searching, I hadn’t said a word.
hunks.sol: Even after Namho’s gaze toward him had grown sharper and more searching, Taekyung hadn’t said a word.

hunks.baseline: Not once.
Not even now.
hunks.sol: Not once, even now.

hunks.baseline: The moment he voiced the question that had been circling in his mind, a short answer came from behind him without a hint of hesitation.
hunks.sol: The question had been circling in Sama Pyo’s mind for so long. The moment he finally voiced it, a short answer came from behind him without a hint of hesitation.

hunks.baseline: “Shit, I don’t know. You look dark and gloomy on the outside, but… I kept wanting to trust you. Even as everything kept turning into a shitshow, I still wanted to.”
hunks.sol: “Shit, I don’t know. You look dark and gloomy on the outside, but… I kept wanting to trust you. Even as everything went more and more to shit, I still wanted to.”

hunks.baseline: He just clenched his teeth to hold back the heat in his eyes, then continued forward with unsteady steps.
hunks.sol: He clenched his teeth against the heat rising in his eyes and kept walking, his steps unsteady.

hunks.baseline: Somewhere behind him, my voice had already grown faint with distance.
hunks.sol: Taekyung’s voice reached him from somewhere far behind.

hunks.baseline: At my gentler-than-ever command, Sama Pyo didn’t answer.
hunks.sol: Sama Pyo didn’t answer that gentler-than-ever command.

hunks.baseline: He kept walking, through the ruined battlefield where the band of fighters were still hunting down and slaughtering the surviving enemies.
hunks.sol: He kept walking toward the band still moving through the ruined battlefield, slaughtering the enemies who had survived.

hunks.baseline: Or, to be exact, toward the old man standing at their center.
hunks.sol: Or, to be exact, toward the old man at their center.

hunks.baseline: He came to a stop at last. A pool of blood rippled beneath his feet.
hunks.sol: At last, he stopped, sending ripples through a pool of blood.

hunks.baseline: Sama Pyo took a deep breath. The stench and reek of blood were foul enough to make him gag, but his heart was strangely calm and still.
hunks.sol: Sama Pyo took a deep breath. The stench of blood and death filled his nose, foul enough to make him gag, but his mind was calm and still.

hunks.baseline: His heart was as calm and still as the expression of the old man before him, who gazed at his enemy’s son with eyes too deep to read.
hunks.sol: As calm and still as the expression of the old man before him, who gazed at his enemy’s son with eyes too deep to read.

hunks.baseline: “Your junior, Sama Pyo, pays his respects to the Sect Leader of the great Kongtong Sect.”
hunks.sol: “This junior, Sama Pyo, pays his respects to the Sect Leader of the great Kongtong Sect.”

hunks.baseline: Killing intent, so immense it was terrifying, surged up all around him and pressed down on Sama Pyo’s entire body.
hunks.sol: Killing intent, immense enough to be terrifying, surged up from every direction and pressed down on Sama Pyo’s entire body.
